headline: DoorDash to Pay 264,000 NYC Delivery Workers $131.5M Settlement
meta_description: DoorDash agreed to pay $131.5 million to 264,000 New York City delivery workers who were underpaid and received late payments.
summary_short: After a settlement agreement, DoorDash will compensate 264,000 delivery workers in New York City for wage violations and late pay.
body:
DoorDash has agreed to a $131.5 million settlement with 264,000 delivery workers in New York City who were underpaid and received late payments. Every affected worker will receive compensation as part of the agreement.

The settlement addresses a pattern of wage violations affecting a substantial portion of the city's gig workforce. For delivery workers already operating on thin margins, the back pay represents meaningful relief and acknowledgment of months or years of financial hardship.

This resolution signals growing accountability in the gig economy sector, where delivery platforms have faced mounting scrutiny over worker compensation practices. The scale of the settlement—affecting a quarter-million workers in a single city—underscores the scope of the problem and the importance of enforcing wage protections for workers in this growing industry.
quick_facts: 264,000 NYC delivery workers affected by the settlement
All underpaid workers will receive compensation
Settlement addresses underpaid and late wage payments
